floorPlans.introduction: Compare the published one- and two-bedroom layouts, including the balcony variants and listed unit references.
floorPlans.note: Saleable totals include the suite and balcony shown on the sheet. Ranges apply to the units listed for that layout. Confirm the final area for your apartment.

review.images: Six native renderings published in the Woods brochure with the named Retreat section. The Woods courtyard, wellness and interior scenes also appear in other Sobha Woods brochures and are identified as shared setting.
review.location: Physical page 3 of Sobha’s Retreat-specific plan pack marks Retreat. Journey times and named road approaches come from the official Retreat landing page, with directions resolved by name.
review.floorPlans: Thirteen complete residence drawings from physical pages 7–31 of the standalone plan pack. All printed saleable totals were visually checked, including retaining 964.55 where rounded suite and balcony figures add to 964.56. Paired key plans are in the original.
